data.description: Discover Serenity and Luxury at Violet 4 by Damac Properties
data.long_description:
Located in the lush and dynamic community of Damac Hills 2, Violet 4 by Damac Properties offers luxurious four-bedroom townhomes that are perfect for modern families. Designed to blend contemporary elegance with the tranquility of nature, each home provides spacious living areas, modern finishes, and expansive windows that invite natural light and scenic views of surrounding greenery.

The community at Violet 4 is thoughtfully designed to cater to every family member’s needs. Water Town’s exhilarating wave pool offers refreshing fun, while Sports Town provides courts and fields for active pursuits. Nature lovers can explore walking trails and the Zen garden, while children delight in the petting farm, lazy river, and paintball park. Social gatherings are enhanced by barbecue areas and outdoor movie spaces, making community life vibrant and engaging.

With excellent connectivity to major roads, Violet 4 offers a strategic location for commuters and travelers. Dubai Marina, Damac Hills, and major shopping and entertainment hubs like Dubai Outlet Mall and Global Village are all within a short drive. Violet 4 represents the perfect fusion of luxury, family living, and nature-inspired design.

Provident Real Estate
